stemMd:
Although the sample was small ______ the researchers published their observations so that later teams could compare results from other sites. They clearly distinguished these preliminary observations from a final conclusion.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: Although introduces a dependent clause containing two coordinated facts. A comma marks its end before the independent clause the researchers published.

distractorRationale.a: The although clause is dependent and cannot be separated by a semicolon here.
distractorRationale.b: A comma is needed after the introductory dependent clause.
distractorRationale.c: A colon does not correctly close this introductory although clause.
